scenarios.description: New button resets builder and command preview.
preconditions: App running in dev or packaged mode.
Fill method/url/headers/body/grep/jq/cookies and edit command textarea.
steps: Inspect all form fields and the command textarea.
expected: Request fields reset to defaults (GET https://httpbin.org/get, one blank header, empty body).
Cookies reset to a single empty cookie row.
jq/grep fields cleared; command preview/input cleared and mirrors defaults.
visualChecks: Command textarea shows default command without stale tokens.
No residual highlighting or stale toggles remain enabled.

scenarios.description: Loading a history entry populates builder and command preview.
preconditions: Run a request with custom headers, body, jq expression, grep patterns, and cookies to create a history entry.
steps: Review all builder fields and command preview.
expected: All fields (method/url/headers/body/cookies/global options/jq/grep) reflect the saved entry.
Command preview matches the reconstructed request with cookies and filters.
Raw tab reruns curl for the selected history item when opened.
visualChecks: Checkboxes and toggles reflect stored on/off state.
Command textarea updates immediately without mixing with prior state.

scenarios.description: Running a template with variables prompts, applies values, and updates command preview.
preconditions: Create a template containing {{VAR}} placeholders in URL/header/body and at least one cookie.
steps: Fill the variable modal with sample values and run.
expected: Builder fields populate with the concrete values; command preview renders substituted values.
Variable modal closes and status shows the run stages (curl/jq/grep).
visualChecks: Modal labels and inputs align; no clipping at common window sizes.
Command textarea shows substituted values without leftover {{VAR}} tokens.
